description:
Located in Petersfield Green, this maisonette presents a unique opportunity for those looking to settle in central Milton Keynes at an affordable price. The area is well-regarded for its accessibility to local amenities and public transport, making daily commutes straightforward. The property is leasehold, with a build area of 72.93 square metres, providing ample space for comfortable living.

The maisonette features two bedrooms, including a master bedroom with an en-suite bathroom. The layout is designed for convenience and functionality, with two bathrooms to accommodate the needs of residents. Double glazing and gas central heating contribute to a cosy environment, while the balcony offers a pleasant outdoor space to enjoy.

Residence permit parking is available, adding to the convenience of this home. With fantastic views and a top floor position, this property stands out as a great choice for buyers looking for value in a sought-after location. Act quickly to secure this move-in ready maisonette in Milton Keynes.
